$comment: Bench scenarios, see packages/nx-metrics/README.md → Benchmarks. Run: pnpm nx-metrics bench --name baseline

scenarios.name: cold
scenarios.description: everything without cache: pure execution time
scenarios.command: nx run-many -t lint typecheck test build

scenarios.name: warm-local
scenarios.description: everything again, local cache warm (upper bound of the cache effect)
scenarios.command: nx run-many -t lint typecheck test build

scenarios.name: fresh-agent
scenarios.description: fresh CI agent: local state wiped, hits only from the remote cache (needs NX_SELF_HOSTED_REMOTE_CACHE_SERVER)
scenarios.command: nx run-many -t lint typecheck test build

scenarios.name: no-remote
scenarios.description: fresh CI agent without remote cache: baseline for the remote cache effect
scenarios.command: nx run-many -t lint typecheck test build

scenarios.name: pr-leaf
scenarios.description: typical PR: change in a UI lib, warm cache
scenarios.command: nx affected -t lint typecheck test build --base=HEAD

scenarios.name: pr-shared
scenarios.description: worst case: change in a shared lib, warm cache
scenarios.command: nx affected -t lint typecheck test build --base=HEAD

scenarios.name: graph
scenarios.description: project graph computation without workspace data (overhead of many projects)
